Tochka 1 - Interior
Axel: Ugh...!
Eric: Oh ho, Sleeping Prince awakens, does he?
Axel: ...!
Eric: Well, good thing, too. I've no interest in smooching a man, you know.
Axel: Who... are you? And where am I?
Eric: I'm Eric Wang. This is a special Federation research facility... Tochka 1, you see.
Axel: The Federation's...!?
Eric: That's right, Axel Almer.
Axel: If you know my name... you know who I serve, too?
Eric: Mm-hmm. And where you came from... that too.
Axel: ...
Eric: The Cry Wolves recovered the Soulgain, rotting away inside the White Star, and brought it here.
Axel: (The Cry Wolves... I was saved by my enemies from the "other side"?)
Axel: I should have been gravely wounded. Did you people treat me?
Axel: That's impressive medicine. To bring me back from that state...
Eric: Treat you? What are you talking about?
Eric: When we pried open that scorched cockpit hatch... you hadn't a scratch on you.
Axel: What...!? Impossible, that can't be! My arms and legs were...
Eric: Your memory seems muddled. I knew you weren't hurt the moment we opened that cockpit.
Axel: What...?
Eric: You were stark naked, you see. One look made it plain there wasn't a wound on you.
Axel: I was? What does that mean...!
Eric: Don't ask me. You're the one who stripped. Some Shadow Mirror ritual before facing death, was it?
Axel: (...He doesn't seem to be lying. What happened to me...?)
Eric: Ho ho ho. If only you'd been a woman, it'd have been a feast for the eyes.
Axel: ...And my clothes? Weren't they at least stained with my blood?
Eric: Take a look. Not a stain, eh? ...You're wearing them right now.
Axel: ...!
Eric: They were folded beside you, clean as fresh laundry. Shadow Mirror sure is a tidy outfit.
Axel: (Someone else, in the Soulgain? It's impossible... but nothing else explains it...)
Eric: Oh, that's right. I forgot to tell you something important.
Axel: What...? Tell me, what happened to my body...
Eric: ...Only me and a few others saw you naked. All men, so no need to be embarrassed.
Axel: ...I couldn't care less about that.
Axel: While I'm asking, tell me one more thing. ...Why did you save me?
Eric: Hmm, well, it was really your machine we had business with.
Axel: ...What do you want with the Soulgain?
Eric: I want it as reference for a new model. One to destroy a mobile weapon I once designed myself.
Eric: But thanks to those Shura, materials have gotten hard to come by.
Axel: Shura...? Never heard of them... Some new organization?
Eric: Mm, I see. You've been asleep all this time, so of course you wouldn't know.
Eric: The Shura, you see, came from another world, just like you.
Axel: Wh... what?
Eric: They've made a giant sword called the Sodiam their stronghold, and run rampant all over the world.
Eric: It's no all-out war, mind you. But battles break out everywhere, nonstop. A dreadful nuisance.
Axel: (A state of perpetual war... What we strove for... they're doing it?)
Federation Soldier: Doctor Wang.
Eric: Mm. ...Axel, you'll be going into a cell from here on.
Axel: ...
Eric: I'm sure you understand... given what you've done. I'd appreciate it if you came quietly.
Axel: ...I've no intention of making trouble. My war ended back then, that's how it is.
Axel: (Yes, it should have ended. I took wounds no one could survive. So what happened to me...?)
Axel: (I thought I heard Lemon's voice... but surely not.)
